landing.headline: From pilot to proof
landing.subheadline: Track the evidence behind each pilot, validate what changed, and support explainable funding decisions.
landing.reviewRequired: English copy reviewed for clarity. Marathi copy should be reviewed by a native speaker.

landingV2.headline: From pilot to proof.
landingV2.subhead: Follow a public pilot from its approved baseline to a decision, with each action and reason in one shared record.
landingV2.reason1: The baseline and measurement period were approved before the pilot began.
landingV2.reason2: Field evidence was submitted for the agreed measurement period.
landingV2.reason3: An independent validator recorded the review outcome and supporting reason.
landingV2.tamperLive: A record was changed. This demo marks the changed entry and every linked hash after it.
landingV2.tamperReason: This reason was edited in the demo to show how linked hashes reveal a changed entry.
landingV2.officerCopy: Set the baseline, record responsibilities and make the decision trail clear.
landingV2.startupCopy: Submit evidence against agreed milestones and see what happens next.
landingV2.validatorCopy: Review source evidence independently and record a reasoned outcome.
landingV2.storyTitle: A shared record from baseline to decision
landingV2.step1copy: The officer records the starting measure, period and responsibilities before work begins.
landingV2.step2copy: The startup submits evidence for the agreed period. The record links it to the pilot.
landingV2.step3copy: The validator records what they checked and why the evidence supports the outcome.
landingV2.step4copy: The responsible team records a decision and its reasons for the next review.
landingV2.featureAuditCopy: Follow each recorded action, actor, timestamp and reason.
landingV2.featureRolesCopy: Officer, startup and validator responsibilities stay distinct.
landingV2.featureHashCopy: See whether a record changed after it was recorded.
landingV2.featureReasonsCopy: Keep the rationale beside the decision it supports.
landingV2.featureExportCopy: Keep a reviewable record of pilot evidence and actions.
landingV2.featureLanguageCopy: Switch languages while keeping the workflow familiar.
landingV2.securityTitle: A useful check, with honest limits
landingV2.securityCopy: PilotProof links recorded entries so reviewers can see when stored content no longer matches its recorded hash.
landingV2.securityDoesCopy: A matching hash helps show that the recorded content has not changed since that hash was made.
landingV2.securityNotCopy: A hash cannot prove that a measurement was accurate, complete or truthful when it was first entered.
landingV2.securityAccessCopy: Role-based permissions separate officer, startup and validator actions. The record shows who took each action.
landingV2.finalTitle: See how one pilot moves from baseline to decision.
landingV2.footer: Synthetic demo data. No real public procurement activity is represented.
landingV2.loginIntro: Choose a sample role to explore the demonstration workspace.
landingV2.loginDisclaimer: Demo access · No real account is created
landingV2.loginError: Email or password is incorrect. Use demo1234 for the sample accounts.
landingV2.trustLine: Synthetic entries for product demonstration only.
